description: This file defines the MembershipRepository class with methods for managing team memberships, including creation, lookup, and validation, utilizing Prisma ORM and referencing various related entities and external modules.

classes.name: MembershipRepository
classes.description: Repository class providing methods to manage and query team memberships, including creation, validation, and retrieval of membership data with related entities.

methods.name: hasMembership
methods.description: Checks if a user has an accepted membership in a specific team.

methods.name: listAcceptedTeamMemberIds
methods.description: Returns a list of user IDs of accepted members in a team.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new membership record.

methods.name: hasAnyAcceptedMembershipByUserId
methods.description: Checks if a user has any accepted membership in any team with a slug.

methods.name: findAcceptedMembershipsByUserIdsInTeam
methods.description: Finds accepted memberships for multiple users within a specific team.

methods.name: createMany
methods.description: Creates multiple membership records at once.

methods.name: findAllByUpIdIncludeTeamWithMembersAndEventTypes
methods.description: Retrieves memberships including team info, members, and event types based on user profile ID.

methods.name: findAllByUpIdIncludeMinimalEventTypes
methods.description: Retrieves memberships with minimal event type info based on user profile ID.

methods.name: findAllByUpIdIncludeTeam
methods.description: Retrieves memberships including team info based on user profile ID.

methods.name: findUniqueByUserIdAndTeamId
methods.description: Finds a unique membership by user ID and team ID.

methods.name: findRoleByUserIdAndTeamId
methods.description: Retrieves the role of a user within a specific team.

methods.name: findMembershipsWithUserByTeamId
methods.description: Retrieves memberships with user profile info for a team.

methods.name: findAllMembershipsByUserIdForBilling
methods.description: Retrieves all memberships for billing purposes for a user.

methods.name: findByTeamIdForAvailability
methods.description: Retrieves memberships for a team with user credentials and availability info.

methods.name: getAdminOrOwnerMembership
methods.description: Checks if a user is an admin or owner in a team.

methods.name: findAllAcceptedPublishedTeamMemberships
methods.description: Finds all accepted team memberships with published teams for a user.

methods.name: findUserTeamIds
methods.description: Returns all team IDs a user is a member of.

methods.name: findMembershipsCreatedAfterTimeIncludeUser
methods.description: Finds memberships created after a specific time, including user info.

methods.name: findAllByTeamIds
methods.description: Finds all memberships for a list of team IDs.

methods.name: findAllAcceptedTeamMemberships
methods.description: Finds all accepted team memberships for a user.

methods.name: findAllByUserId
methods.description: Finds all memberships for a user with optional filters.

methods.name: findTeamAdminsByTeamId
methods.description: Finds admin or owner members of a team.

methods.name: hasAcceptedMembershipByEmail
methods.description: Checks if a user with an email has accepted membership in a team.

methods.name: hasPendingInviteByUserId
methods.description: Checks if a user has a pending invite.

methods.name: searchMembers
methods.description: Searches for team members with filters, pagination, and search term.

methods.name: findAcceptedMembersWithUserProfile
methods.description: Retrieves accepted members with user profile info.

methods.name: hasAnyTeamMembershipByUserId
methods.description: Checks if a user has any team membership (pending or accepted).
